FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 132
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Shay Shelnutt
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/26/2026
Senate Bill 132 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of certain Class 8
municipalities that opt out of the jurisdiction of a county personnel board, pursuant to this bill,
and subsequently create their own municipal civil service system.
